Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1291.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Boss! Gray Raven Commandant! I knew you two would be okay!', 4: '1', 18: '100020263'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "Look what I've got! It's a scan of the amplifier. I actually found it!", 4: '1', 18: '100020264'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Arriving alongside Kiki is a familiar face—Captain Rolmo.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Save the pleasantries for later. Just help me up already!', 4: '1', 18: '100020265'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory211.png'}
{3: 'But for some reason, the vibe feels a little off once you are all inside the lifeboat.'}
{3: 'Karenina is just about to complain about how cramped the cabin is when she realizes something about this feels familiar.'}
{3: 'She decides to drop that train of thought and strike up a conversation with a familiar face instead.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'What happened to those people from Xoth?', 4: '1', 18: '100020266'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "It's chaos there. When the projection vanished, the Choir members practically lost their minds on the spot.", 4: '2', 18: '100020267'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Some are waiting to head back with the next lifeboats, but others fled. The main force is still searching for them.', 4: '2', 18: '100020268'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory896.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory511.jpg'}
{3: 'Looks like the whereabouts of the mermaid Aria, the composer, and his wife will become another unsolved mystery.'}
{3: 'At least, they can finally wake up from the illusion after all this time...'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory211.png', 7: '0|0|0'}
{3: 'No matter how harsh reality might be, at least it is real.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Um, Captain... How long until we get back to the outpost?', 4: '1', 18: '100020269'}
{1: '1', 2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: "Well... It's hard to say. If you want the scenic route, I can take you all back to my place.", 4: '2', 18: '100020270'}
{2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: "If you want the quickest route, it's still the length of a sunday cartoon if I sail safely.", 4: '2', 18: '100020271'}
{2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: "But if everyone's willing to take a risk, we can get there right now!", 4: '2', 18: '100020272'}
{1: '1', 3: "The captain's cryptic answer leaves everyone bewildered."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "What kind of answer is that?! You're making it impossible not to get pissed off here!", 4: '1', 18: '100020273'}
{3: 'His deliberately lowered voice seems to be hiding something. Then, when Karenina finally recalls his name—'}
{3: 'She notices that the copy of "The King in Yellow" on the terminal has been replaced with a different book. Just as she\'s about to take a closer look—'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{3: 'The lifeboat suddenly rockets forward, so fast that you all have to grip your seats to avoid being thrown overboard.'}
{1: '1', 2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: "Hold on tight, everyone! We're surfacing!", 4: '2', 18: '100020274'}
{2: "Captain Rolmo, don't accelerate so suddenly!", 3: '69'}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina desperately tries to tell her companions what she's discovered, but the pressure and ringing in your ears caused by the rapid ascent makes it impossible for anyone to hear."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Wait! We've... we've been tricked!", 4: '1', 18: '100020275'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "The helmsman up front isn't... Rolmo!", 4: '1', 18: '100020276'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "It's Roland... the Ascendant...", 4: '1', 18: '100020277'}
{3: "Only when you finally break the surface does Karenina's warning become clear."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "It's Roland! The helmsman is the Ascendant Roland!", 4: '1', 18: '100020278'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'He tricked us before, back when we were returning from the lunar base!', 4: '1', 18: '100020279'}
{1: '1', 2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: "Sharp as ever, Miss Karenina. If you could look past your prejudices, you'd see I'm actually quite the capable captain!", 4: '2', 18: '100020280'}
{3: 'Rolmo wrenches the controls violently, his arms twisting like pretzels.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBubble.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory99.png'}
{3: 'After breaking the surface, his sails are even more recklessly.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFallNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: "All you can do is cling desperately to the door handles to avoid being thrown out. Fighting back isn't even an option."}
{1: '1', 2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: 'Even I have to admit that the ending is rather dull for such a thrilling voyage. Let me add a little excitement for everyone!', 4: '1', 18: '100020281'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFallNew.prefab'}
{3: 'Just as you are about to make your move, "Captain Rolmo" smashes the emergency button.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory537.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiEnd.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: 'The canopy bursts open, and all of you are launched into the air at different angles before you all splash down into the water.'}
{3: 'By the time you grab hold of Karenina and Kiki, all you can see is the lifeboat\'s exhaust trail and "Captain Rolmo" waving and bowing dramatically.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory390.jpg'}
{3: 'Another lifeboat rises nearby. Inside, the exhausted Xoth refugees watch the spectacle unfold.'}
{2: 'Aria', 3: 'They look happy... Unlike us.', 18: '100020283'}
{2: 'Composer', 3: "Yeah, they do. I got so used to seeing you as a mermaid, I almost didn't recognize the real you.", 18: '100020284'}
{2: 'Composer', 3: 'At least your voice is still the same.', 18: '100020285'}
{2: 'Aria', 3: "What about her? She didn't come up with you?", 18: '100020286'}
{2: 'Composer', 3: 'She refused to leave Xoth, but in the end... she let go.', 18: '100020287'}
{2: 'Aria', 3: "The Song of True Love was a lie. I should've known.", 18: '100020288'}
{2: 'Composer', 3: "I heard your lover didn't die. He just lost his memory and went back to the surface. You still have a chance to make things right.", 18: '100020289'}
{2: 'Aria', 3: "Maybe the real world isn't as bad as we thought.", 18: '100020291'}
{2: 'Composer', 3: "Yeah. Sunlight and summer... it's almost hard to get used to them again. Things are probably going to be rough at first, but there's still a chance for us.", 18: '100020292'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory597.jpg'}
{3: 'The moment Karenina surfaces, medical personnel whisk her away.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory232.png', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '3', 3: '11'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The moment your comms connects to the network, you receive a call from Asimov.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Karenina manually disabled and reactivated her visual module?', 4: '11', 18: '100020293'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'During your infiltration, she also switched to a coating provided by an unidentified individual from the underwater base...', 4: '11', 18: '100020294'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'You found an escape route midway through, but then abandoned it?', 4: '11', 18: '100020295'}
{3: "Silence stretches on the other end of the line. You can sense Asimov's suppressed emotions through the call."}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "That's enough for now. I'm hanging up.", 4: '11', 18: '100020296'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Your temporary leave is over. Head back soon, and I'll need a detailed incident report when you return.", 4: '11', 18: '100020297'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '11'}
{3: 'Before Karenina can wake up, you will have to return to your original Mission.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg'}
{1: 'Atlantic Temporary Outpost', 2: 'Earth', 4: 'Several Days Later'}
{2: 'Several Days Later\\nEarth\\nAtlantic Temporary Outpost'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiRegressionInvitation/FxUiRegressionInvitationShine.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A few days later, you and Karenina are reunited, but you both avoid making eye contact.'}
{3: 'Waves crash against the harbor, crumbling into glittering fragments before rolling back into the sea.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'So, for security reasons and a bunch of other nonsense, my conclusion is...', 4: '1', 18: '100020298'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We gotta keep everything about Xoth a secret. Even the tech we're developing has to be encrypted. Am I right?!", 4: '1', 18: '100020299'}
{2: 'Yes. It should stay a secret.', 3: '178'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Hmph. Not like I've got anyone I wanna tell anyway. I'll probably forget all about it in a few days.", 4: '1', 18: '100020300'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "T-that coating... I can't wear it anymore either, can I? Kinda feels like a waste.", 4: '1', 18: '100020301'}
{2: 'We should be able to replicate it.', 3: '183', 4: 'Think of it as an easter egg from the mission.', 5: '183', 6: "I won't tell anyone else, so...", 7: '183'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "What do you think? Sure, we got the amplifier, but that didn't stop her from getting chewed out by just about everyone.", 4: '1', 18: '100020302'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "There's good news though! She passed the evaluation. Starting next month, she will officially be part of the Engineering Force.", 4: '1', 18: '100020303'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Heh heh. The real challenge is only just beginning for her.', 4: '1', 18: '100020304'}
{3: 'Playfulness takes over as she stomps on shells and kicks pebbles along the shore, trying to walk in a straight line with her arms spread wide.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Now that you mention it, what happened to that Choir Administrator? I've been too swamped since we got back to check in on her.", 4: '1', 18: '100020305'}
{3: 'After his arrest, the old man kept clutching a swaddling cloth made from a pillow and claiming it was an umbilical cord no one else could see.'}
{2: '(Explain the situation to Karenina)', 3: '198'}
{1: '1', 3: 'You look down and follow her footprints step by step, until you bump into her. Turns out Karenina stopped walking some time ago.'}
{3: 'She lifts a hand and lightly brushes her nose. Some kind of celebration seems to be underway across the shore, as fireworks burst and streak together into a line.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: 'A group of children gathering shellfish passes by with their buckets, bumping Karenina into your arms.'}
{3: 'The moment throws her off, and she almost forgets what she was about to say.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Commandant, be honest with me... I don't have a romantic bone in my body, do I?", 4: '1', 18: '100020306'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I couldn't say anything nice to save your life, and the second I went off-script, I killed the mood completely.", 4: '1', 18: '100020307'}
{2: "I don't need to hear romantic words.", 3: '221'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I love explosions. Boom, boom, boom... I've been blowing stuff up almost every day since I was a kid.", 4: '1', 18: '100020308'}
{2: 'Bombs are romantic.', 3: '224'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "And I've got a terrible temper! I couldn't get along with anyone when I was little, and I got into fights all the time. I even fought stray cats over food!", 4: '1', 18: '100020309'}
{2: 'You should apologize to the cats.', 3: '227'}
{2: "And next time there's a fight, count me in.", 3: '228'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: 'Karenina grows flustered and grabs you by the shoulders, shaking you.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "You don't get it, Commandant! You big idiot!", 4: '1', 18: '100020310'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I'll always be Karenina of the Engineering Force first. Not just some girl named Karenina.", 4: '1', 18: '100020311'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Once I left Xoth, I went back to being the same old Karenina, covered in soot and making a racket!', 4: '1', 18: '100020312'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'No more adventures, no more lights, no more custom coatings, no more songs.', 4: '1', 18: '100020313'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I don't read much, apart from files and technical manuals. I haven't seen many movies, and I can't tell good coffee or wine from the bad ones.", 4: '1', 18: '100020218'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I like hiding away where no one can find me, and I've got 23 overdue reports...", 4: '1', 18: '100020219'}
{2: "What else don't I know about?", 3: '243'}
{2: 'Whatever matters to you, we can do it together.', 3: '244'}
{2: 'One by one. Every single one.', 3: '246'}
{2: "Don't deny who you are over things that don't matter.", 3: '249'}
{2: "And... don't deny us.", 3: '250'}
{3: 'The fireworks begin, blooming against the night sky like a postcard from the final scene of a movie.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiRegressionInvitation/FxUiRegressionInvitationShine.prefab'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1076.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2.5', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1076.jpg', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{3: "The light and shadow converge on Karenina's face, painting her features with the texture of an oil canvas."}
{3: 'There are countless roses in the world that look the same, but the Little Prince can always recognize his rose.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory784.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '2.3', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory784.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hah... This is the real world. Everything we say and do counts!', 4: '1', 18: '100020221'}
{2: 'And because this is the real world, that means...', 3: '270'}
{3: 'Before you can finish, she presses her finger gently against your lips.'}
{3: 'Then, Karenina leans in and kisses her fingertips softly.'}
{3: 'Dusk and night trade places overhead. Orange and deep blue streak the same clouds.'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1076.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.9', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1076.jpg'}
{3: 'The fireworks keep going for so long that you end up covering her ears the whole time to protect her from the noise.'}
{3: 'Her ears burn hot beneath your touch. So reality can mirror dreams after all—miracles hide in every breath she takes, waiting to be discovered.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina's breathing grows heavier as she buries her face against your chest, her thoughts unraveling completely."}
{3: 'Her eyes remain closed. The fireworks explode like stars overhead, and those stars... they are all Karenina.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hmph. Turns out I can climb over the fence.', 4: '1', 18: '100020222'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I'm the captain here, after all. If I can't keep us on course, we'd be totally screwed.", 4: '1', 18: '100020223'}
{2: 'Aye aye, Captain.', 3: '296'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V470hailuoNormal01.png'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryGoldDust.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: "In Karenina's pocket, that ordinary seashell glimmers once more."}
{3: 'The phonograph is real. The anchor tracker is real. The lucky seashell is real.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryGoldDust.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6101_25.jpg', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg3901_32.jpg', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiSummerSign/FxUiSummerSignLizi02.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg3901_33.jpg', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{3: 'This moment is real. The flutter in your chest is real. Karenina is real.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiSummerSign/FxUiSummerSignLizi02.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Karenina_favor/V470_02_02.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.8', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Karenina_favor/V470_02_02.jpg', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{3: 'Even in a fictional narrative, everything experienced within it is real.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory773.jpg'}
{3: "The ocean floor holds countless secrets. They will be forever hidden, until the whispers at your ear murmur once more... Perhaps they will. Perhaps they won't..."}
{3: 'Let what lies beneath the waves stay buried. Only what surfaces will be remembered.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_49.jpg', 7: '0|0|-150'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiEnd.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab'}
{3: 'To Xoth! To summer! To love and courage!'}
